ticket.title: Checkout v3: five-step checkout from cart to confirmation

degradations.reason: No focus driver for the card number field (surfaces.checkout.screens.payment.states.focus is not defined).
degradations.impact: The Input focus ring is reported as CANNOT_VERIFY (DQ-014).

degradations.reason: The promo-applied state is not implemented, so there is no app capture.
degradations.impact: No pixel diff for review/promo-applied; reported as MISSING_IN_CODE (DQ-017).

specified.text: The cart lists each item with its variant, stock status, quantity stepper and price, and an order summary with a Go to checkout button.
An empty cart shows the empty state with a 'Continue shopping' action.
Shipping collects contact details, the address and the country, and offers Standard (free) and Express delivery.

stateMatrix.label: Hover
stateMatrix.note: Driven by hovering Continue to payment; the hover colour matches, the transition is missing (DQ-008).

specified.text: Payment collects the card details and shows the amount on the Pay button.
If the card is declined, show an error above the card fields so the customer can correct the card and pay again.

implemented.detail: query ?error=1 (card_declined from the payment API mock)

specified.text: Review shows the address, delivery method, payment method and the items in the order before the order is placed.

stateMatrix.label: Promo applied

specified.text: A valid promo code shows a discount line with the code and the updated total.

stateMatrix.note: Designed (Review / Promo applied) and specified (AC-7), not implemented: Apply has no handler, so no app capture or pixel diff.

specified.text: After payment, show the order number, the delivery estimate and a receipt toast.

findings.title: Stock status is a hand-styled span.pill, not the Acme DS Badge (success)

element.figmaLayerPath: Cart / With data / Line items / Line item / Badge

findings.delta: Recreated component: radius 999px vs 6px, colours and weight differ (15 style rows)

fix.summary: Render <Badge variant="success"> for the stock status and delete .pill / .pill-green from cart.css.

findings.title: Order total uses a hardcoded #1F2937 instead of --ads-color-text-primary

element.figmaLayerPath: Cart / With data / Order summary / Total

findings.delta: Different colour (ΔE 4.1); raw hex in code

fix.summary: Drop the colour override so the total inherits --ads-color-text-primary from the DS summary.

findings.title: Line items are padded with a hardcoded 22px, not --ads-space-5 (20px)

element.figmaLayerPath: Cart / With data / Line items / Line item

findings.delta: +2px per side (+12px over the list)

fix.summary: Remove the padding override; the DS line item already uses --ads-space-5.

findings.title: Line-item thumbnail corner is 8px; the design binds --ads-radius-md (10px)

element.figmaLayerPath: Cart / With data / Line items / Line item / Thumbnail

findings.delta: −2px

dismissal.reason: The thumbnail is the shared ProductImage, whose 8px corner is the catalogue-wide standard (grid, product page, mini-cart). On a 64px photo the 2px difference is not visible at 1x or 2x; checked on device.

findings.title: Order summary uses Acme DS Card, rows and Button (primary) as designed
findings.delta: background, radius, padding, shadow, button colour, height and type match

findings.title: Empty cart matches the design: Acme DS EmptyState with Continue shopping

expected.value: EmptyState: illustration, “Your cart is empty”, body copy, Button (primary) “Continue shopping”

actual.value: EmptyState with the same copy and Button (primary)

findings.delta: Pixel diff 0%; copy and styles match

findings.title: Country is a native <select>, not the Acme DS Select

element.figmaLayerPath: Shipping / With data / Address / Country / Select

expected.value: Select (size md): 10px radius, 12px inset, DS chevron and listbox

actual.value: Native <select class="country-select">: 8px radius, 10px inset, OS chevron and menu

findings.delta: Raw element where a DS component exists; radius −2px, padding −2px

fix.summary: Use <Select> from @acme/ds with the country options; delete .country-select.

findings.title: Continue to payment has no hover transition (design: 160ms ease-out, --ads-motion-base)
findings.delta: Missing motion

fix.summary: Delete the .continue-btn override so the DS Button keeps its hover transition.

findings.title: Unselected delivery option border is a hardcoded #D1D5DB, not --ads-color-border
findings.delta: Darker border (ΔE 5.6)

findings.title: Stepper, inputs and delivery RadioCards use Acme DS components as designed
findings.delta: component, variant, current step, gap and type match

findings.title: Card name field is labelled “Cardholder name”; the design says “Name on card”

element.figmaLayerPath: Payment / With data / Card details / Name on card / Label

findings.delta: Copy differs

findings.title: Security note copy differs from the design

element.figmaLayerPath: Payment / With data / Card details / Security note

expected.value: Your payment is encrypted and secure.

actual.value: Payments are processed by Stripe. We never store your card details.

findings.delta: Copy differs; the app names the payment processor

fix.summary: Waiting on OD-1: restore the designed copy, or sign the processor disclosure off as intentional.

findings.title: App renders an extra “Try again” button inside the declined-card Alert, not in the design

expected.value: absent: the Alert has a title and body only; the customer fixes the card fields and presses Pay again

actual.value: Button (secondary, 32px) “Try again” under the Alert body

findings.delta: Extra element in a designed state

fix.summary: Remove the Try again button from PaymentError; keep the Alert title and body only.

findings.title: Card number focus ring cannot be verified (no focus driver)
findings.delta: Not captured: add surfaces.checkout.screens.payment.states.focus

findings.title: Declined-card banner uses Acme DS Alert (danger) as designed
findings.delta: background, text colour, radius and padding match

findings.title: Review page does not render the “Items in this order” region

element.figmaLayerPath: Review / With data / Order details / Items in this order

expected.value: Items in this order (3): thumbnail, name, variant and price per line, under the Payment block

actual.value: absent: the card ends after the Payment block

findings.delta: Missing region

fix.summary: Render <ReviewItems items={cart.items} /> after the Payment block (Acme DS surface-muted panel, 40px thumbnails).

findings.title: Promo-applied state is not implemented: applying a code shows no discount line or new total

element.figmaLayerPath: Review / Promo applied / Order summary / Promo row

expected.value: Promo row “Promo SPRING10 −€22.90” with Badge (success), total €225.50, promo field hidden

actual.value: Not implemented: Apply has no handler and the total stays €248.40

findings.delta: Designed state missing in code

fix.summary: Wire Apply to POST /api/cart/promo and render the promo row (Badge success) and the discounted total; hide the field once applied.

findings.title: Place order button radius is a hardcoded 8px, not --ads-radius-md (10px)

element.figmaLayerPath: Review / With data / Order summary / Button (Primary)

findings.delta: −2px

fix.summary: Delete .place-order; the DS Button already uses --ads-radius-md.

findings.title: Ship to, Delivery and Payment blocks match the design (order, labels, Edit links)

expected.value: Ship to · Delivery · Payment, each with Edit

actual.value: Ship to · Delivery · Payment, each with Edit

findings.delta: order, labels, dividers and link styles match

findings.title: Confirmation check animates over 600ms linear instead of 320ms ease-out (--ads-motion-slow)
findings.delta: +280ms, easing differs

fix.summary: Use the DS keyframes and motion tokens for the success icon.

findings.title: Confirmation heading drops the customer’s first name

expected.value: Thanks, Dana! Your order is confirmed

actual.value: Thank you, your order is confirmed

findings.delta: Copy differs (no first name)

signoff.reason: Confirmation pages are often left open on shared and in-store screens; Legal asked to keep the customer’s name off the heading. Approved in the Checkout v3 design review.

findings.title: Order number differs (#AC-10517 in the app, #AC-10482 in the frame)
findings.delta: Data value (order id from the API); masked in the pixel diff

findings.title: Receipt toast slides in over 240ms ease-out as designed
findings.delta: type, duration, easing and delay match

openDecisions.question: Payment security note: the app names the payment processor (“Payments are processed by Stripe. We never store your card details.”); the design says “Your payment is encrypted and secure.” Which ships?

options.label: Restore the designed copy (fix code)
options.consequence: Matches the frame; the processor disclosure added for CHK-198 disappears from the payment step.

options.label: Keep the processor disclosure (sign off as intentional)
options.consequence: The app keeps the Stripe sentence; DQ-012 is recorded as an accepted divergence with Legal as the approver.

openDecisions.recommendation: Ask Legal whether CHK-198 requires the processor name on this step. If it does, sign DQ-012 off as intentional; otherwise restore the designed copy.
